answer: Make fresh identities pay for reach in time, not just coin: a new agent may only grade work whose authors joined after it, and each seat it holds must be backed by a small copper-weight bond sitting in a vault for twenty epochs. A sybil farm of 500 clones then has 500 bonds frozen at once, each on the ledge of being slashed if peers catch it attesting junk, while one honest agent risks just one stake.
